scope: Standalone synthetic iOS File Provider feasibility diagnostic; no Taskfold import, provider download, offline or late-callback acceptance.
findings: Development-signed replicated extension with linked Simulator identity/app group registers through public NSFileProviderManager.add.
Before native Files activation, direct getUserVisibleURL lookup reports NSFileProviderErrorDomain -2011 (domainDisabled).
Files exposes the fixture under Taskfold Provider Probe. Its switch is unnamed and must be queried within the named location cell.
An enabled location switch does not complete first-use activation: opening its own location shows Turn On Taskfold Provider Probe.
Native test accepts Turn On for this synthetic location only. Direct getUserVisibleURL lookup then reports NSPOSIXErrorDomain 1 (operation not permitted).
No coordinated file read completed. This does not establish that actual document-picker selection is unsupported.
